lessons.advice: When investigating GROUP BY ambiguity with a Subquery annotation, inspect how annotation aliases are passed to get_group_by_cols and whether they collide with joined-table columns. Do not treat unrelated suite success as reproduction of the PostgreSQL issue.

assumptions.statement: Subquery.get_group_by_cols returns [Ref(alias, self)] when alias is truthy.

For an annotation whose get_group_by_cols signature includes alias, Query.set_group_by passes the annotation alias when allow_aliases is true; the shown original method has no joined-column collision check.

scope.inputs: annotation_select contains the annotation; method signature includes alias
